scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with matching Bloom verbs (見分け…選べる / 説明できる / 確かめられる). Each one has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q2, q4, p1–p3 and e1; o2 has q3, e3 and e4 (plus the predict q0); o3 has q1 and e5. Each objective has an apply or analyze item (q1, q4, p1–p3).

hook-problem is a concrete 3-sentence scene (「朝に『テストは `npm test` で実行して』と伝えたのに、午後のClaudeは別のコマンドを試します」) with no trivia. hook-predict q0 is ungraded, tied to o2, and has feedback that names a misconception (「Claudeは会話の中で学習して、性質が変わるわけではありません」). sum-hook answers the scene at the end.

prerequisites list 第1回–第4回, cd/ls and Git commit. Recalled terms are flagged (s3-defs 「（第1回）」, s4-defs 「（第4回）」, s1-lead 「第1回で見たコンテキストウィンドウ」), and the new terms (コンテキスト圧縮 in s2-defs, ルール in s3-defs) are defined before use and match the glossary. 「プランモード（plan mode）の計画」 in s3-table gets no recall line, and タイムゾーン in ex-learn has no English gloss.

measure.mjs gives 「prose 1945 (budget 1,200–2,400) … est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」 and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. Every content section has a table, diagram, list or check. Section 5-2 holds two ideas (clear/compact, and resuming with s2-session/s2-code), and 5-3 is dense: 3 definitions, a diagram, a 3-row table, a fix and a pitfall.

5-5 comes before practice. Its 5 labelled steps each give a reason (ex-pattern 「関係のない話題も広い調べものもなく…」, ex-fix cites the 2-correction rule), and s5-prompt is the full model rewrite. Practice A (p1–p3) diagnoses with hints, but it is not a faded version of the example. ex-learn collects 3 conditions (ずれた行の例, 日付の書き方, タイムゾーン), yet s5-prompt uses only 2 of them.

Every content section except 5-4 has an inline quiz (5-1 q1, 5-2 q2, 5-3 q3, 5-5 q4), so no 2 content sections in a row lack one. The items are new scenarios, not rewordings: q1 asks for a before/after measurement, q4 has the learner pick a rewritten first prompt, and p1–p3 are analyze-level. Every wrong option has feedback.

All 5 misconceptions from the brief are built into the distractors, and each is corrected in 2 sentences or fewer: more context makes Claude smarter (q2 b, p1 d); reopening empties the context (q2 d, p2 c, p3 d); compaction wipes everything or keeps every file (q3 a/c, e3 d); stronger wording fixes it (q0 c, q4 a, e5 a); asking Claude measures usage (q1 d, 「Claudeの答えは、測った値ではありません」).

s3-diagram shows a state change with 6 nodes. Its labels use the text's terms (「決まった
ファイルの
指示」, 「要約に置き換わる」, 「ディスクから
読み直す」), and the caption states the takeaway (「会話は要約に置き換わり、決まったファイルの指示はディスクから戻る」). The alt text lists the four re-read items, and the lesson has no decorative images.

The practice is a hands-on test in a new folder: /context 3 times, a prediction (pr-predict), a focused /compact, and a check of what survived (pr-prompt-b, whose expect admits 「Claudeの分け方は自己申告なので、この2点で確かめましょう」). It has expects, troubleshoot lines, the pr-checklist (6 items) and a model answer (pr-answer). Each hint step has only one hint (pr-predict, p1–p3), so there is no 3-level hint ladder.

The summary section comes after the exam and has all four parts: sum-hook (the answer to the opening scene), sum-points (4 points), sum-next (a reflection 「会話だけで何度も伝えている指示を、1つ書き出してみましょう」 plus 第6回 as the next step) and 8 flashcards. There is also askTutor.

All 5 confirmed findings in audit-cc-05-context.json are in the current text: p2 d 「何が大事かをClaudeが推測して要約します」, e4 b 「コンテキストが上限に近づくと起きる」, s3-lead 「直下のCLAUDE.mdなど、決まったファイルの指示」, the pr-start trust dialog, and s2-session 「前の会話の履歴が戻ります」. The audit has 0 unverified items, and its dropped /btw item stands as written. The version is pinned in s1-lead (v2.1.304), and every behaviour block cites its source. Two loose spots remain (p2 c 「使用量はそのままです」, the expect in pr-context-3), listed as doubts in niceToHave.

です・ます throughout, warm and free of pressure (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「自分で確かめましょう」), with no banned phrases (lint clean). Terms are mostly consistent: 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 is introduced in s2-defs, but feedback in p2 and e4 says 「自動の圧縮」.

The lesson declares jp only and every field is filled. The diagram has Japanese labels and alt text. The link text is descriptive (「コンテキストウィンドウの公式ドキュメント（日本語）」). Plain-text fields (checklist labels, askTutor, table columns, captions) carry no markdown.

niceToHave: s5-prompt (worked example consistency): ex-learn collects 3 conditions, but the prompt holds only 2. Change the third line to 「前に試したときは、{{ずれた行の例}} の日付が1日ずれました。」 and add var {"name": "ずれた行の例", "hint": "例：2026-10-20,1200 の行"}.
pr-predict (practice hint ladder, to reach 4): use three graded hints. (1) 「5-3の図で、それぞれの指示がたどる矢印を見ます。」 (2) 「直下のCLAUDE.mdは『決まったファイル』に入るかを考えます。」 (3) 「会話だけの指示は、要約に置き換わる側です。」

factual doubt (pr-steps-compact pr-context-3): s3-table says up to five recently changed files are re-read after compaction, so in this small folder the drop can be small. Add troubleshoot: 「減り方が小さいのは、最近のファイルが読み直されるためです（5-3の表）。」

factual doubt (pr-diagnose p2 option c feedback): a resumed session restores the conversation history but not every bit of state (audit note on s2-session). Write 「開き直しても同じ会話の続きなので、使用量はほとんど変わりません。空きを作るには `/compact` で要約します。」

check-quiz e5: the item tests reading the loaded-files part of /context, while o3 says 「使用量を確かめられる」. Either widen o3 to 「/context でコンテキストの使用量と、読み込まれたファイルを確かめられる」 (an objective change, so it needs a full review), or keep e5 and add an o3 exam item about usage.
s3-table row 1: write 「プランモード（plan mode、第3回）の計画」 so the term has a recall, like the other recalled terms.
s5-steps ex-learn: on first use, write 「どのタイムゾーン（time zone）の日付として扱うか」.
Term consistency with s2-defs: write 「自動のコンテキスト圧縮」 instead of 「自動の圧縮」 in pr-diagnose p2 option d feedback, the p2 explanation and check-quiz e4 option b feedback.
pr-steps-start pr-start md: after the `\` sentence, add 「`\` の行でEnterを押すと、続きを待つ `>` が出ます。」 so a learner typing line by line is not surprised by the continuation prompt.
pr-code: the echo line is already split, so the full rule fits. Write 「echo '- <title>は「練習：」で始める' \」 to model a complete instruction, and update pr-checklist / pr-answer if needed.

Brief drift: content/courses/claude-code/briefs/cc-05-context.md still has the heading 「Brief: vibe-coding/cc-05-context」 and calls the lesson a draft with courseId vibe-coding. It also quotes the CLAUDE.md line as 「- HTMLの<title>は「練習：」で始める」, while pr-code has 「- <title>は「練習：」から」. Update the brief to match the published lesson.
summary: This is a full review because the lesson moved from the vibe-coding drafts to content/courses/claude-code/lessons/ (courseId claude-code), and the gate no longer accepts the earlier review chain. The content hash is unchanged (sha256:4b4ffd1dc9356064). Its biggest strength is the line from a concrete hook, through misconception-based checks, to a hands-on test that has the learner predict and then see what survives compaction. Every fix from the fact audit is in the text. Nothing must be fixed; the most useful optional changes are a 3-level hint ladder on pr-predict and adding the missing row example to s5-prompt, so the worked example uses all three conditions it collects.
